notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/magistral-medium-1-0-25-06). It is a product/lifecycle page (date, context 40k, features, retirement), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Modalities appear only as icons with the label Modalities and no plain-text modality names, so modalities is not_stated. Header date June 10, 2025 is treated as releaseDate (description also says released June 2025). Blog (mistral-magistral-blog) and Technical Report PDF (mistral-magistral-paper / arxiv 2506.10910) are linked from the page but are separate seed documents, not listed under this card by seed-lookup, so they were not read. alsoDocuments empty. No pageCount (web page).
